concerns.text: FR-045 requires retaining edges only if an adjusted p‑value ≤ 0.05, but the `predicted_edges.schema.yaml` contract (referenced by FR-011/FR-013) defines only `protein_id_1`, `protein_id_2`, and `correlation`. Without an `adjusted_p_value` field the pipeline cannot be validated against the schema, making the requirement untestable. Either extend the schema to include an `adjusted_p_value` column (and update FR-011/FR-013 accordingly) or remove the adjusted‑p‑value filter from FR-045.
